reason: Harness cluster: bash-denied-after-hook-rewrite and tool-result-directives both govern how the agent treats what hooks and tool output return to it (a rewritten call is refused; a result tells the agent what to do). One class, two labeled sections. Umbrella created here; both narrow siblings archived with absorbed_into.

A coordinating session was re-fired by the Stop hook about 8 times with the same "uncommitted changes, commit and push" order and a Canny done-gate on scratch drafts. Each time the right move was a one-line "nothing to commit, no check applies, stopping". The skill covers rewrites and orders in general but not this stop-hook pattern.

Three Bash calls in this episode (commit, merge push, athena block) were denied first because the hook rewrote them to rtk form. Each passed once the prefix was written by hand, so the first attempt should already carry it.
